title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Cleaning the Kitchen 😂 ADHD Cleaning Be Like #shorts
description:
ADHD cleaning: one counter turns into seven jobs.

Started with one plate. Ended up cleaning the junk drawer at midnight. 😂 What job ALWAYS turns into five? 👇

Tip: pick one zone, set a timer, and leave the side quests on a sticky note.
